description: N58 piano lines from the N58 'Piano (D)' 8-bar tables (A aeolian over Am7). The rhythm is walked over the whole 8-bar cycle (no half-bar form) up to a fixed last note on beat 1 of bar 8, held a whole note; that note's pitch is drawn from the tables. Rhythm seed by track (one rhythm per track), melody seed by cycle (shared by all tracks). 16 tracks x 50 cycles = 400 bars. No chord shifting or filtering.
